title: Tip from Angela - Building a Programming Habit
summary: A short motivational tip on habit building: attach the new coding habit to an existing routine so the old habit acts as a trigger.

concepts.heading: Habit stacking with a cue
points: Pick a habit you already do reliably (for example brushing teeth) and perform the new habit straight after it.
The existing routine becomes the trigger, so you do not rely on remembering or on willpower.
Applied to coding: choose a fixed daily cue, then do a set block (about 30-60 minutes) of coding right after it.
Keep the new habit specific and small enough to start immediately, with nothing else slotted in between.

pitfalls: Leaving the habit unanchored so something else always gets in the way.
